# Automation & Remediation

Track what the SRE Agent **can** do, what it **did**, what **requires approval**, and **rollback** status - the agent's automation surface with guardrails front and center.

> **SRE Agent at the center.** This page is an operating surface for both humans and the SRE Agent. Set the **Subscriptions** and **Log Analytics workspace** parameters, then act on the Top 10 recommendations below.

## Automation posture at a glance

Health of the automation itself over the last 30 days: outcomes and whether the guardrails are blocking or actions are failing.

content.query:
SREAgentActions_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize Failed = countif(Outcome=='Failed'), Blocked = countif(Outcome=='Blocked'), Total = count()
| extend Posture = case(Failed > 0, 'CRITICAL', Blocked > 0, 'DEGRADED', Total > 0, 'ELEVATED', 'HEALTHY')
| project Posture, ['Actions (30d)'] = Total
content.title: Automation posture

content.query:
SREAgentActions_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize Actions = count() by Outcome
| order by Actions desc
content.title: Action outcomes

content.query:
SREAgentActions_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize Actions = count() by Outcome
content.title: Outcome mix

content.json:
## Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

Prioritized, auditable actions the **SRE Agent** has produced for this page, ranked by `RecommendationScore`. Each row is evidence-backed and carries its agent action type, approval requirement, and lifecycle status.

- **Approval required = true** -> the agent will *not* act without human sign-off (always true for SLO, alert, remediation, health-model, access, or panel-deletion changes).
- Use the **Evidence / Incident / PR / Runbook** links to drill into the supporting data.
- Source table: `SREAgentRecommendations_CL`. If empty, no active recommendations exist for this page, or the workspace parameter is not yet set - see *Configuration* in the README.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where WorkbookName == "Automation & Remediation" and WorkbookPage == "Automation & Remediation"
| where Status in ("New","Pending approval","Approved","In progress","Failed")
| where isnull(ExpiresOn) or ExpiresOn > now()
| where "{Severity}" == "All" or "{Severity}" == "" or Severity == "{Severity}"
| where "{BusinessCriticality}" == "All" or "{BusinessCriticality}" == "" or BusinessCriticality == "{BusinessCriticality}"
| where "{OwnerTeam}" == "*" or "{OwnerTeam}" == "" or OwnerTeam =~ "{OwnerTeam}"
| where "{RecommendationStatus}" in ("Active","All","") or Status == "{RecommendationStatus}"
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| order by RecommendationScore desc, Severity asc, LastUpdated desc
| take 10
| project
    Rank,
    Severity,
    Recommendation = RecommendationText,
    Scope = AffectedScope,
    OwnerTeam,
    Confidence = ConfidenceScore,
    ['Agent action'] = AgentActionType,
    ['Approval required'] = ApprovalRequired,
    Status,
    ['Last updated'] = LastUpdated,
    Evidence = EvidenceLinks,
    Runbook = RelatedWorkItem,
    Incident = RelatedIncidentId,
    PR = RelatedPullRequest,
    RecommendationId
content.title: Top 10 SRE Agent Recommendations

## Pending approvals

Recommendations whose agent action is blocked on human sign-off. Approving authorizes execution per `AgentActionType`.

content.query:
SREAgentRecommendations_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Status == 'Pending approval'
| summarize arg_max(LastUpdated, *) by RecommendationId
| project LastUpdated, Severity, RecommendationText, AgentActionType, AffectedResourceId, RemediationRisk, RollbackAvailable, OwnerTeam
| order by LastUpdated desc
content.title: Actions pending approval

## Remediation execution history

Every agent-initiated action and its outcome. The audit trail for what changed, when, by whom (or which agent), and whether it can be rolled back.

content.query:
SREAgentActions_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project StartedOn, ActionType, TargetResourceId, Outcome, Approver, RollbackAvailable, CompletedOn
| order by StartedOn desc
| take 200
content.title: Remediation history

## Success / failure rate

Reliability of the automation itself. A rising failure rate for an action type is a signal to pause it and review.

content.query:
SREAgentActions_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Total = count(), Succeeded = countif(Outcome=='Succeeded'), Failed = countif(Outcome=='Failed') by ActionType
| extend SuccessRate = round(100.0*Succeeded/Total,2)
| order by Failed desc
content.title: Outcome rate by action type

content.json:
## Failed remediations

Actions that failed - candidates for rollback verification and root-cause review.

content.query:
SREAgentActions_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Outcome == 'Failed'
| project StartedOn, ActionType, TargetResourceId, BlockedReason, RollbackAvailable
| order by StartedOn desc
content.title: Failed remediations

content.json:
## Blocked actions & guardrails

Actions the agent declined to run, with the guardrail that stopped them. This is the system working as intended - review for false positives only.

content.query:
SREAgentActions_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Outcome == 'Blocked'
| summarize Count = count() by BlockedReason
| order by Count desc
content.title: Blocked actions by reason

content.json:
### Guardrails
The agent blocks an action when any guardrail trips:

- Blocked by policy / Blocked by RBAC / Blocked by business hours
- Blocked for production / Blocked due to missing owner
- Blocked due to insufficient confidence / Blocked due to missing rollback
- Blocked because Service Health indicates a platform issue

Guardrail changes are **approval-required** and versioned.

---
### Operating model (safe-update)
Live data on this page refreshes automatically. Changes to the **workbook definition** follow the suite's safe-update model:

| Change | How it happens |
| --- | --- |
| Live data refresh | Automatic |
| Low-risk metadata (titles, descriptions, layout) | Agent may auto-apply, versioned |
| Medium/high-risk panel or query changes | Pull request + human approval |
| SLO, alert, remediation, health-scoring, access scope, panel deletion | **Mandatory approval** - agent records a recommendation only |

Every change is versioned, validated, auditable, and reversible. See `docs/operating-model.md`.
